name: Costa Rica (1838–1840)
description: Three equal horizontal stripes of light blue, white and light blue, with the seal of the Free State of Costa Rica in the centre of the lower blue stripe.
history: Variant of the state flag used after Costa Rica withdrew from the Federal Republic of Central America in November 1838: the federal arms were dropped from the white stripe and only the state seal on the lower stripe was retained. It was superseded in 1840 by Braulio Carrillo's white-blue-white flag.

features.role: seal of the Free State of Costa Rica
